slug: 2026-06-15 Namibia encouraged by Angola on datacentre establishment

facts.fact: ITWeb reports that Namibia has announced a national datacentre as a core pillar of its 2025-2029 digital strategy, with no dates set for the facility; the article gives the strategy's period but not whether its text is public. Dated by publication.

systems.tiers: national data centre named as a core pillar; scope otherwise not described
adopted in 2022 per the Minister; implementation plan still to be developed

note: The 2025-2029 digital strategy is not described beyond one pillar, so its class is left empty.
